newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Erbakan to address nation on Africa trip.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan to address nation on Africa trip.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan was to address the nation on television on Wednesday evening about his controversial African tour, the prime minister's office said.
"He will speak about the African tour," a spokesman at the prime ministry told Reuters.
The recorded address, scheduled to be shown at 9 p.m. (1800 GMT), is to be screened by all Turkey's state-run and private channels, the spokesman said.

Erbakan's weekend visit to Libya drew scathing attacks from Ankara's close ally, the United States, and prompted an opposition challenge to his rule that analysts predict would tarnish but not topple the Islamist-led coalition.
MPs will probably debate the visit next Tuesday and decide on the same day whether to hold a vote of censure against Erbakan later.
During his tour, Erbakan also visited Egypt and Nigeria.
